description: Run live web and news search across up to 5 queries with structured snippets and URLs. Pass `q` (single query) or `queries` (array of up to 5 strings; billed per query) and optional `limit` (1-20). Returns `results[]` with `title`, `url`, `snippet`, and `source`. Do not use to extract full content from one known URL (use fetch_web_markdown) or for crypto-only feeds (use get_crypto_news). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC/query).

category.description: Filter by category: web or news

fields.description: Return only these result keys, e.g. ["title","url","enrichment.sentiment"]

limit.description: Max results to return per query (default 50, max 500)

q.description: Search query — supports AI, crypto, finance, tech, biotech, energy topics

queries.description: Batch: array of up to 5 queries; priced unit price x count

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

name: search_web
title: Live web search JSON
